premise: Duckling and Caterpillar think Bee is painting the flowers yellow, follow her from flower to flower, and find out she is carrying the yellow dust that helps flowers make seeds.
inspiration: A Just So-style question (Kipling), answered truly instead of tall: not how the flower got its colour, but what the bee is really doing.
lesson: Watching carefully shows you how the world works.
learning: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, and that is how seeds begin

en-US.title: Following the Busy Bee
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {duckling:enter} Duckling came waddling through the meadow… and stopped. {duckling:face surprised} A fuzzy {bee:enter} bee was buzzing from {flower:enter} flower to flower, and her legs were covered in yellow dust. [curious] Is she painting them yellow? he wondered. {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar came crawling up to see. [excited] Let's follow her! {caterpillar:live} She reared up tall, swayed, and gazed up at Bee… then came down with a happy wiggle. {caterpillar:face happy} {sfx:buzz} Bzzz! Bee landed on a flower, {flower:wobble} and the yellow dust stuck to her legs. Bzzz! She flew to the next one, {bee:sparkle} and some dust fell off there. {duckling:shake 0.5} [gasps] She's not painting! said Duckling. She's carrying it! {bee:face happy} That's right, said Bee. {flower:face happy} It helps the flowers make seeds. {bee:live} Then she took a deep breath, hummed a happy tune with her eyes closed… and did a little waggle dance. {duckling:face happy} [happily] So they followed her all afternoon, bzzz, {sfx:quack} quack, bzzz, {all:hearts} the busiest helpers in the meadow.

es-ES.title: Siguiendo a la abeja
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {duckling:enter} Patito cruzaba el prado anadeando… y se paró. {duckling:face surprised} Una {bee:enter} abeja peludita zumbaba de {flower:enter} flor en flor, y tenía las patitas llenas de polvo amarillo. [curious] ¿Las estará pintando?, se preguntó. {caterpillar:enter} Oruga llegó reptando para verlo. [excited] ¡Vamos a seguirla! {caterpillar:live} Se estiró bien alta, se balanceó y miró a Abeja… y luego bajó meneándose, contenta. {caterpillar:face happy} {sfx:buzz} ¡Bzzz! Abeja se posó en una flor, {flower:wobble} y el polvo amarillo se le pegó a las patas. ¡Bzzz! Voló a la siguiente, {bee:sparkle} y un poco de polvo se quedó allí. {duckling:shake 0.5} [gasps] ¡No está pintando!, dijo Patito. ¡Lo está llevando! {bee:face happy} Eso es, dijo Abeja. {flower:face happy} Este polvo ayuda a las flores a hacer semillas. {bee:live} Luego respiró hondo, tarareó una canción alegre con los ojos cerrados… y se puso a bailar, meneándose. {duckling:face happy} [happily] Así que la siguieron toda la tarde, bzzz, {sfx:quack} cuac, bzzz, {all:hearts} los ayudantes más ocupados del prado.

buzz.prompt: a small friendly bee buzzing past, soft and short
